books.title: The Woman of Fire
books.blurb:
The people I left behind were never the people I thought they were.

I grew up believing that the first hands to hold me would be...
books.chronology: Book 1 of the Eyes of Fire Series

excerpts.title: The People I Left
excerpts.content:
The metal walls of the bunker felt colder than usual. Echoes of footsteps reverberated through the long, sterile corridors of Area 51. I knew what they wanted. I knew what they were going to do.

Time was a fracture, an illusion I was about to break. And the stitched leather mask they forced upon me was just the beginning.

excerpts.title: What's Left in Me?
excerpts.content:
I opened my eyes and the world was burning.

Not with fire, but with a light that shouldn't exist in 1400s Italy. The air smelled of ash and old magic, a stark contrast to the sterile scent of the underground labs.
